title: SSH password vault registration descriptor

hostKey.description: Canonical base64 of the 51-byte SSH Ed25519 public key wire format; runtime verifies all 19 prefix bytes.

hostFingerprint.description: Runtime requires SHA256 of hostKey bytes; digest output uses unpadded base64.

stageCommand.description: Runtime enforces well-formed Unicode, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, and exact stageCommandSHA256 binding.

windowsAbsolutePath.description: Runtime additionally requires unchanged win32.normalize output, no empty/dot/space-ending components, no trailing backslash, and no colon within components. Native broker verifies real owner, file identities, no reparse links and exclusive root handles.

$comment: This schema describes registration data only. Runtime verifies cryptographic cross-field bindings, strict field types, Unicode/byte bounds and Windows path normalization. Native broker additionally verifies current SID, SSH/broker hashes, root identity and host pin. Registration validity is not proof of saved credentials, authenticated SSH, CLI readiness or provider access. Passwords must never occur in this descriptor.
